Jamie (People Ops): Quick help — pharmacist says they need BIN/PCN from my card and the portal view shows blanks. I have an urgent refill.
HR Support Bot: Hi Jamie! The Benefits Portal should have a PDF with full fields. Go to https://benefits.redwood.com -> My Benefits -> Insurance Cards. SSO required. If PDF fails, call carrier 1-800-555-1212.
Sana R.: If the portal view is missing BIN/PCN it's usually the mobile preview. Click 'Download PDF' -> open on device. That version typically includes BIN/PCN, Group, Rx BIN, PCN, and Member ID.
Alex H.: I tried download but PDF only shows member & group, no BIN/PCN. Pharmacist still couldn't process.
Sana R.: Okay — two options: 1) DM me the last 4 digits of the member ID and I can confirm the BIN/PCN with the carrier, 2) pharmacist can look up by name + DOB + employer (Redwood) and confirm eligibility while we get the routing fields fixed.
María P.: FYI for dependents: make sure you selected the correct subscriber in the card dropdown (I once grabbed spouse card and it lacked pharmacy fields).
Jamie (People Ops): DMing last 4 now. Also — pharmacist asked for Rx BIN vs medical BIN. Which do we have?
Sana R.: Good call. Most cards list "Rx BIN" and "PCN" for pharmacy. If your plan uses a PBM, the Rx BIN may be different. I'll verify both values with carrier.
HR Support Bot: Note: Enrollment changes (new dependents, toggles) can take up to 72 hours to propagate to the ID card PDF. If you recently changed elections that might explain missing fields.
Alex H.: Pharmacist accepted name+DOB+employer and processed the refill. They saved a claim reference. If claim denies later for wrong bin, what should we do?
Sana R.: If claim denies due to routing, open a ticket with benefits@redwood.com and include: pharmacy claim ref, date of service, NPI (if available), and the member ID. We escalate to the carrier and request a reprocess with correct BIN/PCN. Usually resolved within 7-10 business days.
Jamie (People Ops): Thanks — saved instructions. Appreciate the quick help.
Sana R.: No problem. Ping me if carrier comes back with a different BIN/PCN than what the portal shows; we'll correct the portal artifact. :thumbsup:
María P.: Adding note: for out-of-state pharmacies, sometimes they need the plan phone number on the card. That number is also on the PDF.
Jamie (People Ops): Closing thread — refill done. :white_check_mark:
